command:
import sys, time
worker = int(sys.argv[2])
x = worker + 1
n = 0
t0 = time.monotonic()
deadline = t0 + float(sys.argv[1])

    x = ((x * 1103515245) + 12345) & 0xffffffff
    n += 1
sys.stderr.write(f"python3 int_loop ops={n} elapsed_s={time.monotonic()-t0:.6f} worker={worker} sink={x}\n")
